Lemma
[reduced-length bound for admissible minimizers] Source: cao-zhu ↗ lem:cz-surgery-cap-reduced-length-barrier 1. Assertion (7.5.6)\group Curvature Estimates after Surgery Let $\tau \in [0,\frac{1}{2}]$. If for each $s\in [0,\tau ]$, $\inf \{ \bar{L}(y,s)\ |\ \mbox{ } d_t(x_0,y)\leq A(2t-1)+\frac{1}{10}\mbox{ with }s=1-t\} $ is achieved by admissible curves, then we have \begin{align} & \inf \left\{ \bar{L}(y,\tau )\ |\ \mbox{ } d_t(x_0,y) \leq A(2t-1)+\frac{1}{10}\mbox{ with }\tau =1-t\right\} \\ & \leq 2\sqrt{\tau }\exp (C(A)+100). \nonumber \end{align}
